name: Negroni
desc: Equal parts gin, Campari and sweet vermouth, stirred and served over a large cube.

source.title: Negroni
source.evidence: Same 1 oz each gin, Campari and sweet vermouth, stirred with ice and strained over one large cube with an orange peel.

ingredients.raw: 1 wide strip orange peel, for garnish

steps: Add the gin, Campari and vermouth to a mixing glass and fill it halfway with ice.
Stir until well chilled and properly diluted, about 20 seconds.
Put the large cube in a rocks glass and strain the drink over it.
Twist the orange peel over the surface to express its oils, then drop it in.
tips: The Kitchn chills the rocks glass in the freezer for 5 minutes first and stirs for about 30 seconds.

references.title: Negroni (Just 4 Ingredients)
references.usedFor: chilled glass, stir time, wide orange peel
